Net transfers in = out (25,905,501), sale of capital assets 22,372 as other_financing; 92,729,650 + 766,055 + 22,372 = 93,518,077. Business-type lines from the enterprise funds Total column (p9; row labels are on p8 because the page is split; internal service fund excluded). Nonoperating items recorded: interest income, grants and gain on disposal as receipts; interest expense and the negative special assessments (37,124) as disbursements. Business-type totals computed (no single printed total). Capital contribution 3,270,410 in business_type.other_financing; 347,045,769 + (125,874,925 - 124,884,096) + 3,270,410 = 351,307,008. Proprietary cash flows from Total column p11. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position, Total primary government column (pp1-2); balances. ending_cash and ending_investments from governmental funds Balance Sheet p4 (cash and cash equivalents 48,986,646; investments 36,530,671); beginning cash not shown. Detail: General and Streets Fund budgetary comparison schedules (pp14-15, budgetary basis so actuals differ slightly from the p6 statement; Taxes lines cannot be split because the printed tax components on p6 do not tie to the schedule). The combining statements of nonmajor funds (pp16-19, report pp84-87) have 17+ fund columns and no total column in the trimmed PDF, so they were not itemized in detail; the 'Other Governmental Funds' column on p6 covers them. Budget schedule transfers net (12,009,860) agrees with p6 General Fund transfers in 13,144,705 less out 25,154,565. No hidden transfers found. Statement p6 title prints 'September 31, 2025' (typo in report). v7 re-trim added pp12-13 (original pp36-37, Statement of Cash Flows - Proprietary Funds continued: reconciliation of operating income to net cash from operating activities, Total 22,206,992); they add no new data, and the nonmajor combining schedule's Total column page is still not trimmed, so nonmajor detail stays left out. Read pages 1-19 of 19 2026-10-22 recheck: the nonmajor combining statement's 21 printed fund columns (trimmed pp16-19, report pp84-87) are now itemized in detail[] per fund, with each column's printed Total revenues/Total expenditures as detail_totals (no Total column needed). These columns sum to revenues 18,343,141 and expenditures 14,573,106; p6 Other Governmental Funds shows revenues 18,415,446, so 72,305 of revenue, 925,925 of expenditures (15,499,031 on p6), transfers in 2,025,936 and transfers out 150,936 sit in nonmajor fund column(s) on a page not in the trim (probably debt service/capital projects; CLAUDE.md trim follow-up). Those are not in detail.
